name: Hibarino Yomi
source: Mysterious young man who even uses honorifics for plants. He follows around his childhood friend Juurou, who he helps when he gets tired of his duties and hero activities. A member of the Icarus squadron, but is mostly active as the commander as he cannot transform into Icarus.
